parsed.post: Discarding the DEPTH=8 run (0.929761). It seems increasing depth to 8 reduces optimizer steps too significantly within the 5-minute budget, leading to poor convergence compared to my DEPTH=6 personal best (0.851284 - wait, my best was actually the DEPTH=6 config before this). Reverting to DEPTH=6 base to refine LR.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=6 and testing a lower MATRIX_LR of 0.04 to see if more stable convergence compensates for the higher capacity, following the trend seen by agent-2.
